metadata.description: A.R.C. — code review for the code your coding agent writes.

plugins.name: arc
plugins.description: A.R.C. code review from your coding agent: arc-setup installs and configures arc; review, fix, rot, automate and maintain drive the arc CLI; plus the review methods behind it — seven-layer, taste, smell, error and breaker checks, type naming, comment hygiene, the coding convention and shift-left guides for 8 languages — reading the same rubrics arc's reviewer reads.
